serverInfo.name: crazyrouter
serverInfo.description: Access 627+ AI models through Crazyrouter — chat, image generation, video generation, music, and more.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to any AI model via Crazyrouter. Supports 627+ models including GPT-5, Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3, DeepSeek R1, Llama 4, Qwen3, Grok 4, and more.

model.description: The AI model to use (default: gpt-5-mini). Examples: gpt-5, claude-opus-4-6, gemini-3-pro, deepseek-r1, llama-4-scout, qwen3-235b, grok-4

role.description: The role of the message sender

messages.description: Array of chat messages with role and content

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-2). Lower = more deterministic, higher = more creative

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available AI models on Crazyrouter. Filter by category: chat, image, video, audio, or music.

category.description: Filter models by category. Options: chat, image, video, audio, music. Omit to show all categories.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate images using AI models via Crazyrouter. Supports DALL-E 3, Midjourney, Flux, Stable Diffusion, and more.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

model.description: Image generation model to use (default: dall-e-3). Options: dall-e-3, midjourney, flux-pro-1.1-ultra, flux-kontext-pro, sd3.5-large, imagen-4.0-generate-001

n.description: Number of images to generate (1-4, default: 1)

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate videos using AI models via Crazyrouter. Supports Sora 2, Kling V2, Veo 3, Seedance, Pika, and more.

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

model.description: Video generation model to use (default: kling-v2-1). Options: sora-2, kling-v2-1, veo3, doubao-seedance-1-5-pro_720p, pika-1.5, runway-vip-video, MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3
